description: 小田急線各駅の乗降客数(旧R5・P40 3-2交通(1)小田急線各駅の乗降客数) [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 狛江市. （資料について） ・小田急電鉄株式会社交通企画部より提供。 （注意事項） ・一日平均乗降客数は、千人単位に四捨五入。. Coverage: 狛江市. The portal files it under the publisher 狛江市. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
